posts.text:
🧾 CHEK — official channel

What: a meme project launching on Solana with one rule — every claim comes with a receipt.
Token: $CHEKD — NOT LAUNCHED. No contract address exists yet. Any token using this name or ticker before our launch is not affiliated with this project.

Official links (only these):
• Site: {{SITE_URL}}
• X: {{X_URL}}
• Build log: {{SITE_URL}}/history
• Receipt bot: @chekcoinsol_bot

⚠️ Admins never DM first. We never ask for a seed phrase, private key or “wallet validation”.

the bot prints receipts 🧾

write any claim to @chekcoinsol_bot → get a CHEK receipt → share it.
or on the site: {{SITE_URL}}/print

no wallet, no sign-up, no token needed.

the plan, itemized 🧾

NOW (live): website · receipt generator · this bot @chekcoinsol_bot · build log · receipt board
LAUNCH: $CHEKD on Pump.fun — the contract address appears at the same minute on {{SITE_URL}}, in the X pin and pinned here
AFTER (planned): proof of hold · holder votes · receipt of the week · meme generator
NEVER: presale · price promises · DMs first

lore drop: the villains 🧾

THE SHREDDER — eats evidence. deleted tweets, wiped sites, vanished devs. leaves confetti.
THE COUPON — “100X OFF! TODAY ONLY!” always expiring, never real.

chek prints. they hate that.

how $CHEKD launches — the receipt, in advance 🧾

• Pump.fun, SOL pair. Name CHEK, ticker CHEKD.
• No presale, no whitelist, no free team allocation.
• The creator makes one public buy at creation (target ≈ $200) from the creator wallet — same curve as everyone. Exact SOL, CHEKD and % of supply are published from the chain.
• The contract address appears at the same minute on {{SITE_URL}}, in the X pin and pinned here.
• Creator fee: Pump.fun pays the creator {{CREATOR_FEE}} of bonding-curve trades (as checked {{FEE_CHECKED}}).

A name or ticker proves nothing. Only the address does.

lore: THE COUPON 🧾

“100X OFF! TODAY ONLY!” — always expiring, never real.
chek read the fine print and stamped it VOID.

🧾 $CHEKD launches {{LAUNCH_UTC}} on Pump.fun.

The contract address will appear at the same minute:
• on {{SITE_URL}}
• in the X pin ({{X_URL}})
• pinned here

The official CA doesn't exist before that minute. Tokens with the same name or ticker are not ours — only the address counts. Admins never DM first.

30 minutes 🧾

The CA appears here (pinned), on {{SITE_URL}} and in the X pin — at the same minute. Not in DMs, not in replies, not from look-alike accounts.
5 minutes. Anything posted before our pin isn't ours.

the creator receipt 🧾

Creator wallet: {{CREATOR}}
Spent: {{CREATOR_SOL}} SOL
Received: {{CREATOR_TOKENS}} CHEKD ({{CREATOR_PCT}} of supply)
It was a buy in the creation transaction — same bonding curve as everyone. Free allocation: 0%.
Tx: https://solscan.io/tx/{{CREATION_TX}}

Live creator position: {{SITE_URL}}/transparency

24h receipt 🧾

• launched on Pump.fun, CA {{CA_SHORT}} — same on site, X and here
• launch + creator receipts, on-chain verified
• receipts printed by people: {{RECEIPTS_PRINTED}}
• build log: {{SITE_URL}}/history

No price talk. That's the recap.

🎁 CHEK TELEGRAM DROP — open

This one is only for the channel:
Airdrop: the first {{TG_AIRDROP}} valid entries get {{TG_AIRDROP_EACH}} $CHEKD each.
Draw: {{TG_WINNERS}} random wallets × {{TG_EACH}} $CHEKD.

How to enter: write your public Solana address in the comments under this post (or send it to @chekcoinsol_bot). One address per Telegram account, channel subscribers only. The bot marks a valid entry with 👍.

The main drop runs on X: every drop post there is its own round ({{X_ROUND_WINNERS}} × {{X_ROUND_EACH}} $CHEKD from the replies under it) plus {{X_AIRDROP_EACH}} each for the first {{X_AIRDROP}} accounts — separate list, you can enter both: {{SITE_URL}}/drop

Source: the creator's own launch buy. Draws 24 h after launch, seed = a published Solana blockhash. Tokens are SENT within 48 h after the draw; every transfer is published as an on-chain receipt. Only if $CHEKD launches.

We never DM first. No claim site, no wallet connect, no fees.

Telegram drop update 🧾 {{TG_ENTRIES}} entries so far.

The first {{TG_AIRDROP}} get the airdrop, every entry is in the draw. Entry and rules: the pinned drop post.

The X drop is separate — reply on X, then paste the link at {{SITE_URL}}/drop.

We never DM first — report anyone who does.

{{TG_ENTRIES}} entries in the Telegram drop 🧾

Not in yet? Comment your public Solana address under the pinned drop post. One per Telegram account.

Both drops stay open until 24 h after launch. Draw seeds = Solana blockhashes, published together with the winners. Every transfer gets an on-chain receipt.

Telegram drop entries so far: {{TG_ENTRIES}}. X drop: {{SITE_URL}}/drop

4 hours left to enter the Telegram drop 🧾 Comment your address under the pinned drop post.
